36	  x  ∙ (x \\ y)  ≈⟨ assoc x (x ⁻¹) y ⟨

113	  ε        ∎

116	⁻¹-involutive = selfInverse⇒involutive ⁻¹-selfInverse

119	x∙y⁻¹≈ε⇒x≈y x y x∙y⁻¹≈ε = begin
120	  x         ≈⟨ inverseˡ-unique x (y ⁻¹) x∙y⁻¹≈ε ⟩
121	  y ⁻¹ ⁻¹   ≈⟨ ⁻¹-involutive y ⟩
122	  y         ∎

125	x≈y⇒x∙y⁻¹≈ε {x} {y} x≈y = begin

127	  y ∙ y ⁻¹ ≈⟨ inverseʳ y ⟩
128	  ε        ∎

134	⁻¹-anti-homo-∙ x y = ∙-cancelˡ _ _ _ $ begin
135	  x ∙ y ∙ (x ∙ y) ⁻¹    ≈⟨ inverseʳ _ ⟩
136	  ε                     ≈⟨ inverseʳ _ ⟨
137	  x ∙ x ⁻¹              ≈⟨ ∙-congʳ (//-rightDividesʳ y x) ⟨
138	  (x ∙ y) ∙ y ⁻¹ ∙ x ⁻¹ ≈⟨ assoc (x ∙ y) (y ⁻¹) (x ⁻¹) ⟩
139	  x ∙ y ∙ (y ⁻¹ ∙ x ⁻¹) ∎
140	
141	⁻¹-anti-homo-// : ∀ x y → (x // y) ⁻¹ ≈ y // x
142	⁻¹-anti-homo-// x y = begin
143	  (x // y) ⁻¹      ≡⟨⟩
144	  (x ∙ y ⁻¹) ⁻¹    ≈⟨ ⁻¹-anti-homo-∙ x (y ⁻¹) ⟩
145	  (y ⁻¹) ⁻¹ ∙ x ⁻¹ ≈⟨ ∙-congʳ (⁻¹-involutive y) ⟩
146	  y ∙ x ⁻¹         ≡⟨⟩
147	  y // x ∎
148	
149	⁻¹-anti-homo-\\ : ∀ x y → (x \\ y) ⁻¹ ≈ y \\ x
150	⁻¹-anti-homo-\\ x y = begin
151	  (x \\ y) ⁻¹      ≡⟨⟩
152	  (x ⁻¹ ∙ y) ⁻¹    ≈⟨ ⁻¹-anti-homo-∙ (x ⁻¹) y ⟩
153	  y ⁻¹ ∙ (x ⁻¹) ⁻¹ ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (⁻¹-involutive x) ⟩
154	  y ⁻¹ ∙ x         ≡⟨⟩
155	  y \\ x ∎

157	\\≗flip-//⇒comm : (∀ x y → x \\ y ≈ y // x) → Commutative _∙_
158	\\≗flip-//⇒comm \\≗//ᵒ x y = begin
159	  x ∙ y                ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (//-rightDividesˡ x y) ⟨
160	  x ∙ ((y // x) ∙ x)   ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (∙-congʳ (\\≗//ᵒ x y)) ⟨
161	  x ∙ ((x \\ y) ∙ x)   ≈⟨ assoc x (x \\ y) x ⟨
162	  x ∙ (x \\ y) ∙ x     ≈⟨ ∙-congʳ (\\-leftDividesˡ x y) ⟩
163	  y ∙ x                ∎
164	
165	comm⇒\\≗flip-// : Commutative _∙_ → ∀ x y → x \\ y ≈ y // x
166	comm⇒\\≗flip-// comm x y = begin
167	  x \\ y    ≡⟨⟩
168	  x ⁻¹ ∙ y  ≈⟨ comm _ _ ⟩
169	  y ∙ x ⁻¹  ≡⟨⟩
170	  y // x    ∎
